findings.text: _cites_a_commit answers the same question promotion's _manifest_cites_a_commit at reckon/crew/promotion.py:2412 already owns, and the two now disagree: an all-zero commits value is refused by the audit here but read as a citation by promotion's predicate, so an implement run with commits: 0 and in-repository changes is refused by check-manifest yet promoted by the same rule the node unified the role set to share.

the reviewed manifest leaves baseline_suite and after_suite empty and names its base and head arms only under test_logs and evidence_inputs, so a reader that derives the run's added failures from the structured suite fields, which the promotion suite-delta check reads, finds them unnamed and must fall back to test_logs.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the audit is reached from reckon/cli.py:crew_check_manifest, the crew check-manifest command.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 07ad28145; d01ccfca8 replaces the review-only role test with the imported commitless-role set, 276997646 adds _cites_a_commit so an all-zero value is read as a count rather than a citation, and 5159261a4 records the fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: section 38's done_when requires an investigate manifest with commits: none to read clean, an implement manifest with none still refused, and 0 not accepted as a citation; tests/test_check_manifest_reads_the_commitless_roles.py covers all four cases and the manifest records 5 passed EXIT=0 at head against 3 failed EXIT=1 at the base mutation.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that check-manifest reads its commitless-role set from the one promotion uses; reckoned at reckon/crew/reports.py:1081, which imports promotion's _COMMITLESS_ROLES and returns False for a role in that set, so the audit a worker runs and the gate promotion applies share one set.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the focused gate (5 passed EXIT=0), the declared base mutation (3 failed EXIT=1), a 518-passed population either arm and names the logs on disk; its baseline_suite and after_suite lines are empty, the two arms being named only under test_logs and evidence_inputs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_check_manifest_reads_the_commitless_roles.py, docs/evidence/fragments/crew-observability-truth/check-manifest-reads-the-commitless-roles.html and a figures directory; the diff 07ad28145..5159261a4 touches exactly the first three, every path inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: my base-arm re-run and the recorded negative control show the investigate[none], investigate[[]] and zero-citation cases redden at reckon/crew/reports.py:1079-1083 when the role set and the zero predicate are reverted, so each added assertion fails on the regression it claims to guard.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_check_manifest_reads_the_commitless_roles.py covers all four done-when cases and my own re-run of the named test reads 5 passed EXIT=0 at head against 3 failed EXIT=1 at base, but the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite lines are empty, so the suite arms are named only under test_logs.
justifications.fit: _cites_a_commit at reckon/crew/reports.py:1500 is named and documented by mechanism, but its capability is owned by reckon/crew/promotion.py:2412 _manifest_cites_a_commit, and the two predicates now disagree on commits: 0.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:1081 imports promotion's _COMMITLESS_ROLES rather than restating the set, so the audit and the promotion gate cannot disagree about which roles owe a commit.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 07ad28145..5159261a4 touches reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_check_manifest_reads_the_commitless_roles.py and the declared evidence fragment, 229 insertions against 9 deletions, all inside the declared write paths.
